source: Measured on the ML infra topic's Storage lab and shown on Storage and data movement (systems_and_performance/topic_ml_infra_and_orchestration/storage_and_data_movement, src/parts/22_js_sd_iodata.js, key prefetch): one container reads one 4 MiB token shard per step and computes for 100 ms (a sleep standing in for the GPU), 16 steps, median of 3 runs; 'none' fetches the shard when needed, 'prefetch2' keeps two shards in flight. Stores: an S3-compatible store in a container, and a Docker volume. Copied unchanged 2026-10-24.
